payload.entry: LANDING FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (bob-cli-kx.2.1.land): Every child PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP was reviewed. (1) kx.2.1.1 #1, the mounted bob-plugins validation.md -> bob-vim-yank-flash.md#verification link: declined, because the bob-cli-kb landing already repaired it (kb landing notes record the validation.md fix); not caused by this epic. (2) kx.2.1.2 #1, parallel-load flakes: subprocess_runner pipe-drain reproduced in this landing's just check and passed alone, so bob-cli-kl got a +1. The complete_themes flake is already tracked by bob-cli-g8, but it was not reproduced in this run, so g8 got no +1. (3) kx.2.1.4 #1 and kx.2.1.5 #2, the 44-45 lib and 2 CLI clean-base failures in albums/bank/record/capture/gcal: declined as already fixed on master (b7f74b58 and other later commits). This landing's just check at 1863b39b fails only 2 lib and 1 CLI tests, none of them in those areas. (4) kx.2.1.5 #1, lychee mac-capture/event-notes: duplicate of bob-cli-l7. The bad link is still at docs/gcal-notes.md:17, so l7 got a +1. (5) kx.2.1.7 #1, event-ack.md has no front matter, blocking docs-gen/docs-check: caused by active epic bob-cli-l5 (b6ed0e59, l5.1), recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE note on bob-cli-l5. (6) kx.2.1.7 #2, gcal sync_args alias test: duplicate of bob-cli-l2, reproduced, +1. (7) New in this landing: tests/cli/catalog.rs expects 97 entries but the catalog has 98 after 1863b39b (bob-cli-l5.3.1.2). Recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE note on active epic bob-cli-l5.3.1. Integration: the post-start commits are all gcal/albums/records/glossary work, and none consumes or conflicts with the archive feature, so no integration edits were needed. epic-symbols: none.

LAND AUDIT: NOT READY TO CLOSE. Verified all seven phases' commits (677e7407, 92b52e4f, 4c2cb878, 8e78584d, 0b806ae8, 62ad26d7, 54fc8c61) against plan:202611/gmail_archive_core.md and confirmed these epic-caused defects in source. (a) Planning, apply, and recovery compute A/U from the current scan's saved_ids, never the close's frozen saved_ids, so a save between retries archives unfrozen mail, the journal rejects the event, apply returns Ok silently, and the receipt is left unowned. (b) Terminal-event None after a successful remote write is silently Ok across archive, recovery, and let-go. (c) First-use archives journal the receipt label with id None, and let-go/recovery match message label IDs against names, so let-go records release without removing the receipt. (d) An archive_label change after enablement is never re-baselined, so archives go unjournaled. (e) A [?] linker writes an open observation that parse_open_observation rejects, holding the thread forever. (f) The boundary revalidation compares a row with the same scan it came from: no lock and no re-read. (g) The live loop ignores each row's planned decision and creates the label even when only Kept rows exist. (h) Recovery is shadowed by the consent/unsaved checks. (i) Let-go reaches beyond the recorded IDs and is skipped while the gate is paused. (j) apply_live(...)? drops the filing/watch report, and archiving still runs after failed or incomplete filing. (k) Saved IDs are captured after watch hydration. (l) A dry-run before enablement shows nothing. (m) A supplied mismatched -c is ignored when confirmation is not required. (n) A -q live run leaks the digest, and kept/let_go rows are hollow. (o) Sync help still says 'Sync is read-only in Gmail', several docs are stale, and json-outputs.md lost text in 54fc8c61. (p) There are no real property tests. Remaining work is planned as the child epic sase_plan_gmail_archive_landing_repairs.md (phases ownership -> boundary -> integration -> surfaces) with parent_bead bob-cli-kx.2.1. just check at 1863b39b fails only 2 lib and 1 CLI tests: the gcal alias test (bob-cli-l2), the subprocess pipe-drain flake (bob-cli-kl), and the catalog 98-vs-97 count (bob-cli-l5.3.1). None is caused by this epic.

CHILD LANDING BLOCKER: bob-cli-kx.2.1.8 is still incomplete at f508aa46. Its land audit found incomplete final-scan handling, synthetic bypass race tests, lost same-run archive rows on fatal errors, unresolvable/auth accounting gaps, and a reproduced property-generator panic (file:explicit:1e7c765d5bd3a77bc9aa19a1). A medium finish tale will own these repairs plus kx.2.1.8 closeout, a fresh audit and conditional normal close of this plan, and parent phase kx.2 completion (including its accepted i4 supersession). The existing parent follow-up dispositions were reread; the new .8.4 docs proposal was corroborated on l7. Keep this parent open until that work verifies.

Re-audited the parent contract, all seven original closed phases and notes, and the completed nested repair epic. The child fixes close the remaining defects in fresh-scan completeness/race tests, partial live results, unresolvable/auth accounting, and the property generator; all descendants are closed and no epic symbols remain. Rechecked the previous follow-up dispositions: bob-cli-l2 still reproduces; bob-cli-kl failed under the full gate but its exact isolated rerun passed; bob-cli-l7 remains the docs-check offline relative link and already has corroboration. Earlier catalog/glossary and mounted bob-plugins link issues no longer appear: docs-gen and docs-check lint/generated/build/URL stages pass, and just check reports only l2 and kl. No new follow-up was warranted. Verification: 65,536 property cases, all 184 Gmail integration tests, docs-gen, and docs-check stages; full just check has only the two independently tracked failures.
